summary: Sprint 2 frontend retest. PlayerGame.jsx crash fix verified — the mySelection guard now correctly checks q && selectedForQid && selectedForQid.qid === q.id, so PlayerGame renders cleanly on mount. Two-context Playwright flow (host + 2 players, isolated contexts) exercises the entire live gameplay end-to-end and every single review-request assertion passes: player auto-navigation to /play/:pin/game with 4 tiles, tap-to-lock immutability, per-question review with player-feedback-correct (+N points) and player-feedback-incorrect, player-mini-leaderboard with the player's own row highlighted, host-review-question-text (duplicate host-question-text no longer present on review), host-show-leaderboard-btn → host-leaderboard with leaderboard-row-*, host-next-btn advance + 'Finish game' label on last review, host-skip-btn → review, host-end-btn opens host-end-modal → cancel closes / confirm ends game, host-game-over + player-game-over with rank and Back-to-home button.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ws_room player finally block sets players[pid].connected=False on close without checking whether a newer WS (game route) has replaced the same player_id in room['connections']. Cosmetic only — the connected flag will flip back to true on the next room_state after the game WS is fully established — but during a fast /lobby→/game route change it briefly shows the player as disconnected in the host's players list. Consider guarding the flag flip with `if connections[pid] is websocket:`.

server.py: with 2+ players opening WS simultaneously the preview ingress occasionally delays initial room_state by a couple seconds; not a code bug, but tests should wait_for_selector on player-answer-0 with generous (>=10s) timeout rather than reading tile count immediately after URL change (added to seed_sprint2 test guidance).
PlayerGame.jsx line 77 fix is correct. No further logic issues in the render tree — all Sprint 2 selectors render as designed.

HostGame.jsx: 'Finish game' label appears on last review both in the reveal card AND in the Show-leaderboard view — good, both host-next-btn buttons share the same testid and label; make sure only one is mounted at a time (currently gated by !showLeaderboard/showLeaderboard, so this is fine).
useRoomSocket.js retries close with a fixed 1500ms interval — no exponential backoff; acceptable for MVP but flags for future hardening.

server.py: broadcast_room_state on ws close reveals player as disconnected even when the same player_id has already opened a fresh WS; consider `if connections.get(pid) is websocket` before flipping connected=False in the finally block.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 2 is fully green (backend pytest 26/26 in iteration_2; frontend end-to-end in iteration_3). Reuse /app/tests/seed_sprint2.py to bootstrap a room+quiz+players in one shot. For any subsequent testing, prefer isolated browser contexts per role (host, player1, player2) — sharing one context leaks localStorage between pages (each ts_player_{pin} key is pin-scoped, so ok, but ts_host_{pin} would collide if host & player use same pin+context). Use time_limit=15s on questions to give WS + React state hydration room to breathe; questions with time_limit<8s risk the timer expiring before the player tap can complete on the preview URL. Always wait_for_selector('player-answer-0', timeout>=10000ms) rather than reading tile count immediately after URL nav — the /lobby→/game WS handoff takes ~500-1500ms in the preview.
rca of the issue: Iteration 2 blocker (PlayerGame.jsx line 77 crash 'Cannot read properties of null (reading index)') is resolved. Root fix in PlayerGame.jsx: `const mySelection = q && selectedForQid && selectedForQid.qid === q.id ? selectedForQid.index : null;` — explicit null checks on both q and selectedForQid before dereferencing selectedForQid.index. Verified via two-context Playwright driver: PlayerGame mounts cleanly on /play/:pin/game with state=null (before first WS room_state), then re-renders with tiles once question_active state arrives. No console errors, no page-error events observed across host + 2 players over the full 2-question game + game_over + New-Game/Home flows.
